items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Connie Berry. Do you remember Connie Berry? I heard of her, yes.

ctx.x: Oh, we won't forget about Mary Lou. Hazel Scott.
Dorothy Donagan, some of those early -- there's a girl down there in Atlanta, George that used to be on the streets way back in those days. Connie Berry. Do you remember Connie Berry?
